summary: GSK plc files a Form 6-K disclosing a TR-1 major holdings notification. The filing reports that Dodge & Cox crossed the 5% ownership threshold on 23 June 2026, now holding 5.010% voting rights (203,320,168 shares) via ordinary shares and ADRs. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine regulatory notification of a passive stake crossing, not a special situation. Watch for no further action; no risk-arb angle.
